youtube_description:
Last Sunday, Oct. 31 2021, I went hiking at Johnston Mill Nature Preserve in Chapel Hill, NC. There were some beautiful views, including New Hope Creek, Old Field Creek, trails for miles, wildflowers, and a bit of fall color. It was a great time, and it's a great place to visit if you're in the area.

If you enjoy this video, please make sure to like and subscribe!
